stories.title: Argentina and Spain brace for world cup glory—or heartbreak
stories.summary: From Buenos Aires to Barcelona, fans are dreaming, waiting and wondering: who will lift the World Cup on Sunday?

stories.title: Link between raging wildfires and climate change is greater than ever
stories.summary: Human-caused climate change is driving many of the wildfires burning across Canada. What's harder to say is how much worse the planet is because of warming global temperatures.

stories.title: Following your aquarium fish back to its home in the Amazon
stories.summary: We trace the origins of the popular aquarium fish the cardinal tetra back to the Amazon to see how even the most remote corners of the world are transformed by the global economy.

stories.title: Trump promised evidence of election fraud. Experts say there was none
stories.summary: President Trump's primetime address Thursday warned of "shocking vulnerabilities" in U.S. elections, but many election experts say much of Trump's claims amount to old news.

stories.title: Madonna's new album hits No. 1 on the Billboard charts
stories.summary: NPR Music's Stephen Thompson reports on Madonna, Springsteen and Journey's return to the charts.

stories.title: Cyclospora outbreak: FDA says do not eat shredded lettuce from Taco Bell in 5 states
stories.summary: Shredded lettuce served at Taco Bell in Michigan, Ohio, Kentucky, West Virginia and Indiana is linked to cyclospora outbreak. Investigation continues
